parameters:
Bread's been disappearing from the
larder lately. What's going on?

I want someone to look into it, but the
culprit might be in the knight order itself...
Who can I even talk to about this...
I send you the list of new knight candidates.
They are all promising youths for the future.

I apologize for the trouble
as always; please review it.
After it are about five names I don't recognize.

There's a book with these words on
the cover. Should we read it...?

On this Element Continent, the
weapons that are widespread fall

Straight sword: the most ordinary sword,
produced mainly in the Windam Kingdom.

Curved sword: a blade with a curved
edge, produced only in the Flame Kingdom.
Easy to swing, slightly raises agility.

Katana: produced only in Seiryu. A
beautiful, sharp sword. Its edge is
excellent, but it's hard to handle and lowers agility.

There are also great swords —
heavy blades of fearsome power—

and thrusting weapons like
daggers, rapiers, and spears.

These three hit enemy vitals
easily (raising critical rate), but

spears have higher base power than
the other two at the cost of agility.

There's a book with these words
on the cover. Should we read it?

When the Dark Element revives,
each crest — fire, water, and wind—

glows brighter as it strengthens,
granting the inheritor strange magical
That magical power is Elemental Power.

Long ago, before this continent was born,
the power of the crests sealed the Dark

Element far away, and this land flourished under
the blessing of the Fire, Water, and Wind Elements—
or so the legends say. Just what that crest power
truly was, however, is not well understood.

Still, there are tales that the crests'
magical power — Elemental Power — is
none other than the inheritor's very mental strength.

If that's so, then when someone
weak of spirit becomes an inheritor,
their magical power might also weaken.
"Don't Be Scared! Alchemy Without Fear in Five Minutes"

There's a book with these words
on the cover. Should we read it?

It's been about a hundred years
since people called alchemists—

or rather, who call themselves that
— began selling unknown medicines

But since they work wonders, everyone
secretly admires them, right?

What everyone worries about, for
instance, are the potions and such—
specifically, the ingredients used in the medicines.

It's true we don't reveal the
ingredients; we keep them hidden, but
We never use anything dangerous or unclean.

We don't hide the ingredients
because they'd stop selling

if they got out! We just don't
want people casually copying
our highly specialized, difficult methods and
ending up badly injured or sick!
Knights must never disobey the king's orders.

Next, they must not disobey the
Knight Commander's orders either.

Disobey orders and you'll be
stripped of your knighthood.

If you lose your knighthood, you
become a mere soldier or a citizen.
There's a book on this. Should we read it...?

The Element Continent is a land forged
by the Fire, Water, and Wind Elements,
and crests — marks of the Elements' blessing — are
engraved on the back of each inheritor's hand.

These crests begin to shine
when the Dark Element revives,

and are said to prevent the world
from being shrouded in darkness and
overrun by monsters at the Dark Element's hands.
A crest passes to the person its holder trusts most.

But since no one has ever seen
a crest shine, in practice

those in power inherit them.
In the Flame Kingdom, the king;

in Seiryu, the lord; and in
Windam, the Knight Commander.

There's a book with these words on
the cover. Should we read it...?

The Fire Crest breathes flame!
Gyaaaaah — the Dark Element

burned! The Wind Crest summoned
a Kamaitachi, and the fire blazed
even fiercer. Oh no! The flames are so intense we can't
even see the Dark Element! We can't get close!

Alright! Now it's the Water Crest's
turn! When the hero of the Water Crest
raised a hand, a great tsunami appeared.

The fire vanished in an instant.
But the Dark Element was
washed away too, and no one knows where it went.

At this rate, the world will be swallowed by
darkness, monsters will multiply, and the land will

become uninhabitable! But wait
— the hero of Wind is gone!

What!? Transformed into a gale
by the Wind Crest's Hayate,
the Wind hero is chasing after the Dark Element!

His speed is incredible, and
the Fire and Water heroes were
left behind. Now no one knows where the Dark Element

or the Wind hero are. How
will those two meet up again!?
There was nothing worth taking with us...

I am Lord Dear, the
kingdom's scribe, yessir.

I am currently surveying
the kingdom's damage,

I am also compiling intel
on other lands, yessir!

Even this dining hall
has fallen into disuse...
Even the king now eats the same rations

Even this dining hall
has fallen into disuse...
Even the king now eats the same rations

Ugh... this country's
food was already, well...

When the people suffer,
the lord can't be the only
one eating well. That's only natural.
Huh...? Ah, right... yes, that's true...

I've been checking the
castle's damaged sections, and

How many years will it take
to repair everything...

I've been checking the
castle's damaged sections, and

How many years will it take
to repair everything...
Ah, sorry... Prince Hono of Flame...
Flame's is even worse, isn't it...

If we float Seiryu's lumber
and stone down the river...

both this land and Flame
could be rebuilt quickly.
Yeah. But not until the bad weather and
It's the Dark Element... well, anyway—
I-I pray for your fortune in battle!

All these dishes and cloths are so
clean, I'm busy inspecting them!
I wish I could go home...

They say monsters appear,
so I can't get into town
Win! Did you find any interesting books?

Even flying around the
world like you, you'd never
Win! Did you find any interesting books?
Win took out the rare tome and showed it.
I've never seen a book bound like this...

So beautiful and sturdy...
where was it made?
How strange... and it looks new, at that.
Win... are you giving me this book?

I'll start reading right
away, so don't come near me

...I'll just say this: be
careful on the roads at night...
I told you not to bother me, didn't I!!!??
Win, sometimes when you defeat monsters,
you get monster materials or treasure...
it would be of no use to you anyway,
so of course you'd sell it. Oh good~
doesn't do us soldiers or knights any good.

Better to sell them at a shop
and turn them into money, right?
Win, sometimes when you defeat monsters,
you get monster materials or treasure...
Selling them one by one is a hassle, right?
True, monsters don't carry money, but

they didn't have to make
it that realistic...

Well, selling it all at
a shop and getting rich
all at once is kind of fun...
